temp-process.title: Process from a temp folder

log-clearing.title: Audit log clearing

sqli-web.title: SQL Injection in web logs

items.title: Network segmentation
items.description: Docker Compose with separate networks (frontend-net and backend-net). Database and Redis only talk inside the internal network.

items.title: No exposed database ports
items.description: PostgreSQL and Redis do not publish ports on the host. The only exposed ports are 3000 (site) and 8000 (API).

items.title: TLS termination
items.description: In production, a reverse proxy in front of the stack terminates TLS. Inside the trusted network, internal communication runs over HTTP.

items.title: Input validation
items.description: Zod schemas on the frontend form and Pydantic models on the backend. Standardised error messages in problem+json.

items.title: Rate limiting
items.description: Limit of 5 messages per hour per email on the contact form, with a 429 response and Retry-After header.

items.title: Honeypot
items.description: Hidden field in the form. When filled in by a bot, the message is silently accepted and discarded.

items.title: Restrictive CORS
items.description: Allowed origins come from an environment variable; in production there is no origin wildcard.

items.title: Security headers
items.description: X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and X-DNS-Prefetch-Control via next.config. CSP and HSTS are not enabled yet.

items.title: Dependency scanning
items.description: Dependabot, npm audit and pip-audit scheduled in the CI pipeline.

items.title: Secrets management
items.description: No secrets in the repository. .env.example with placeholders and Docker secrets in production.

items.title: Non-root containers
items.description: Containers must run as an unprivileged user; the final user setting in the compose file is pending.

items.title: Minimal data volume
items.description: The database stores only contact messages, lab sessions and audit logs.

items.title: Structured logging
items.description: Logging configured at API startup with a structured format for the audit trail.

items.title: Health checks
items.description: /health/live (liveness) and /health/ready (checks the database) endpoints with a Docker healthcheck in compose.

items.title: Rate limiting on the lab WebSocket
items.description: At most 3 simultaneous connections per IP, short-lived tickets and ping/pong every 30s.

items.title: security.txt
items.description: /.well-known/security.txt file with the responsible disclosure channel.

threats.mitigation: All data access goes through the SQLAlchemy ORM with parameterised queries. No raw SQL with user input.
React escapes output by default. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML with external data.
Silent honeypot, limit of 5 submissions per hour per email and a 429 response with Retry-After.
No secrets committed; .env.example contains placeholders only.
Form submitted as JSON with no session cookie. CSRF tokens for session-based operations are planned.
Rate limiting on the contact form and per-IP connection limits on the WebSocket. Edge protection (proxy) is left for production.
Non-root user, read-only filesystem and reduced capabilities on deploy.
Dependencies pinned by lockfile and automatic vulnerability scanning in CI.
